The '''''Kreytaka''''' was an enormous [[Starship/Legends|starship]] created by the [[Faruun]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. It was meant for use by the [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] during their [[Nagai–Tof War|invasion]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="TFW" /> The vessel was part of an expeditionary force that arrived at [[Kinooine/Legends|Kinooine]].<ref name="SW96" /> It was named ''Kreytaka'' for a [[Kreytaka|city]] on [[Nagi/Legends|Nagi]], although members of the [[Alliance of Free Planets]] referred to the vessel a "longneck transport."<ref name="TFW" />
